resumo: E se algumas das explosões mais poderosas do universo não existirem? É o que sugerem novos estudos publicados na revista Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society , que propõem que estrelas estranhas encontradas na Via Láctea , nossa galáxia, podem não ter vindo das colossais hipernovas , mas sim das já conhecidas supernovas . Antes de continuar, vale recapitular o que são estas explosões cósmicas. titulo: This Windows shortcut fixes monitor glitches, no restart needed
resumo: If your screen suddenly displays strange glitches, freezes, or even goes completely black, often the problem lies with the graphics driver. Instead of restarting the whole PC, there’s a quick and easy solution for this issue: restarting the graphics driver. To do this, press the key combination Windows key + Ctrl + Shift + B – that’s it! By pressing these four keys simultaneously, you are, in a sense restarting the graphics driver. This action occurs by way of the Desktop Window Manager (DWM), which gets reset, and in turn resets the graphics driver. The beauty of this fix is that you can perform it without having to close any applications. That being said, you should probably save any work in progress, as a failsafe, before you proceed. Take note, this fix is only applicable to a software issue. If your monitor’s issues are hardware related — originating with the monitor itself or a failing GPU, or owing to some larger system crash — this hotkey won’t solve your problem. You’ll know the driver has been restarted by a beep or a brief flicker on the screen. The display should now run smoothly again. titulo: Can a Radioactive Ore Break China’s Grip on Rare Earths?
resumo: The global campaigns to break China’s dominance of vital rare-earth markets are shaping up into one of the signature geostrategic struggles of the early 21st century. Hundreds of mining companies, government agencies, and industrial facilities scattered across North America, Australasia, and Europe are striving to wrest share from Chinese firms, which control roughly 90 percent of the markets for rare-earth oxides and rare-earth metals. Rare earths are the ingredients on which vast and crucial manufacturing categories depend: semiconductors , LEDs , lasers, displays, metal alloys, optical lenses, and catalysts for petroleum and chemical processing. Most important, though, are permanent magnets. Essentially all powerful electric motors are based on rare-earth permanent magnets . These motors are the heart of electric vehicles, heating and cooling systems, robots, appliances, and tools. Rare-earth magnets are also in the motors for military systems ranging from tactical drones to ballistic-missile submarines. titulo: India's cobras share genetic ties across the mainland, while Sri Lankan cobras form a distinct genetic lineage
resumo: The spectacled cobra (Naja naja) is one of India's "big four" snakes responsible for most serious snakebite cases. It is currently considered one species, which lives across much of South Asia, with regional differences in color, hood markings and venom. However, it's still unclear which regional cobra populations represent separate evolutionary groups. A new study published in Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution has helped parse out which groups have different lineages, and when and where they may have diverged from their ancestors.
